messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — vendor sync recap: NVIDIA H100/H200, AMD MI300, Habana Gaudi. Need a short plan for marketplace listing + joint announce webinar. Proposed embargo window: 2025-05-12 -> 2025-05-18. Thoughts?
Marie: +1. Who's owning press cadence vs marketplace listing? We need a single source-of-truth for dates.
Jordan: I can own the webinar + partner PR coordination. Suggest tying marketplace GA to the last day of embargo (05/18) so customers can click-through immediately.
Raj: From partner side: H100 is OK for 05/18 if driver microcode lands by 05/05. MI300 team warned of a potential firmware tweak that could slip 1 week. Gaudi has a soft ETA of 05/15 for SI images.
Sam: Lab capacity note: we have limited Gaudi racks week of 05/12. Can do canary images but need to prioritize SI integrations. I'll post a quick matrix.
Sam: ```
Canary plan:
- 05/05: driver + kernel smoke
- 05/08: SI integration dry run (limited)
- 05/12: marketplace canary tag push
- 05/15-05/17: full cert sweep
```
Marie: Good matrix. Can we add an explicit rollback policy for marketplace listing if SI certs fail? e.g., embargo -> soft-launch flag for a subset of regions.
Jordan: Yes — we can do region gating. Proposed rollout flags: beta:us-east, beta:eu-west, full:global on 05/18.
Raj: Vendor ask: please share a simple checklist for driver/firmware versions they must sign off on. I'll ping vendor liaisons once we have that.
Alex: I'll draft the checklist and post here by EOD. Also need comms: talking points for webinar, partner logos (legal ok?), and a 1-page joint FAQ.
Marie: Legal for logos: @announce-bot reminder — request vendor logo approvals (attach ARTIFACTS).
announce-bot: Reminder: vendors must sign logo usage LOA by 2025-05-02 to appear on press materials.
Jordan: Action items: (1) Alex checklist (2) Sam canary schedule + lab booking (3) Raj vendor sign-off (4) I draft webinar invite + registration page. I'll create a calendar invite for 05/13 to align ops and partners.
Sam: Noted — will reserve Gaudi racks 05/08-05/17 and post access table.
Alex: Thanks. If MI300 firmware slips >1 week we hold GA for that SKU and proceed with H100/Gaudi only. We'll make that decision by 05/06.
Raj: Agreed. I'll escalate MI300 risk to vendor PMs today.
Marie: Perfect. Ping here once checklist is up. :thumbsup:
Alex: Checklist posted: https://internal.redwood/drive/hw-announce-checklist (link) — includes driver versions, firmware, canary test pass criteria, legal LOA step.
Jordan: Cool. I'll loop in growth for webinar landing and start a registration draft.
announce-bot: Meeting created: "HW Partner Announce Ops" 2025-05-13 10:00 PT — invites sent.
